label: MODEL_DERIVED — dimensions are engineering estimates from public CereVasc materials; not validated against actual device specs

geometry.mounting_method: ePTFE membrane sleeve bonded to inner lumen wall with medical-grade adhesive
geometry.pressure_relief_geometry: bypass channel, 0.1mm diameter, opens at 15 mmHg differential (design choice — see Task 6)

hydraulic_calculations.interpretation: Membrane reduces flow by ~98.4%. Normal CSF production is ~0.35 mL/min. If Q_with_membrane >= 0.35, drainage is adequate. If Q_with_membrane < 0.35, ICP will rise. This is the critical design constraint.

fouling_dependent_resistance: See Task 5 simulation — resistance increases with fouling percentage
bypass_opening_pressure: 15 mmHg (design choice; see Task 6 fail-safe analysis)
honest_caveats: eShunt dimensions are estimates — actual device specs not retrieved from CereVasc
ePTFE permeability varies by manufacturer; value used is typical, not measured
Membrane area assumes cylindrical sleeve; actual geometry may differ
No validation against in vitro or in vivo flow data
